title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these describes recycling water? (1 mark)
   A. Wasting water
   B. Cleaning used water so it can be used again
   C. Boiling it and throwing it
   D. Letting water evaporate

2. A wrapper of biscuits is made of plastic. Which type of waste is it? (1 mark)
   A. Gas
   B. Liquid
   C. Non-decomposable
   D. Decomposable

3. What should you use to hold a hot cooking pot? (1 mark)
   A. Kitchen gloves or a thick dry cloth
   B. Bare hands
   C. A plastic bag
   D. Wet cloth

4. What is the job of the anus? (1 mark)
   A. To make saliva
   B. To let faeces leave the body
   C. To digest food
   D. To swallow food

5. If you smell gas from a cooker, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell an adult and keep flames away
   B. Turn on an electric switch
   C. Light a match
   D. Ignore it

6. Which of these is a use of friction? (1 mark)
   A. Wasting energy
   B. Machines wearing out
   C. Making parts hot
   D. Brakes stopping a bicycle

7. What is a force? (1 mark)
   A. A push or a pull
   B. A kind of sound
   C. A kind of matter
   D. A kind of light

8. Which of these animals is a reptile? (1 mark)
   A. Tilapia
   B. Hen
   C. Lizard
   D. Butterfly

9. Which of these is a safety rule about the sun? (1 mark)
   A. Never look directly at it
   B. Look at it for a long time
   C. Go out at midday without shade
   D. Shine a mirror in eyes

10. A pupil finds a small animal under a stone. It has a long soft body, no legs and no shell. It is probably (1 mark)
   A. A lizard
   B. An earthworm
   C. A frog
   D. A snake

11. What are the three Rs? (1 mark)
   A. Reduce, reuse and recycle
   B. Reduce, remove and rest
   C. Read, write and run
   D. Recycle, repair and rest

12. What are the symptoms of worms mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Loud voice
   B. Fast running
   C. Clear skin
   D. Seeing worms in faeces, itchy anus, weakness

13. What instrument measures the mass of an object? (1 mark)
   A. Measuring jug
   B. Balance
   C. Thermometer
   D. Clock

14. Which of these is NOT a way of managing solid waste? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing it in a river
   B. Reusing
   C. Recycling
   D. Composting

15. What should you do first if you burn your skin? (1 mark)
   A. Put it under cool running water and tell an adult
   B. Put butter on it
   C. Ignore it
   D. Cover it with soil

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. A school tap leaks 2 litres every hour. How much water is lost in a school day of 8 hours and in 5 school days? (3 marks)

17. What happens in the large intestine? (2 marks)

18. A block is pulled along a rough floor and along a smooth floor with the same force. Describe and explain what you would see. (4 marks)

19. Give two symptoms of an unhealthy digestive system. (2 marks)

20. Give two ways in which water is wasted at school. (2 marks)

21. Give two reasons why solids are useful in daily life. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Cleaning used water so it can be used again
   Recycling cleans water for another use.

2. C — Non-decomposable
   Plastic wrappers do not rot easily.

3. A — Kitchen gloves or a thick dry cloth
   Gloves stop heat reaching your hand.

4. B — To let faeces leave the body
   The anus is the opening at the end of the digestive tube.

5. A — Tell an adult and keep flames away
   Gas can catch fire, so avoid flames.

6. D — Brakes stopping a bicycle
   Brakes use friction to slow wheels.

7. A — A push or a pull
   A force is a push or a pull.

8. C — Lizard
   A lizard has dry scaly skin.

9. A — Never look directly at it
   The sun can harm eyes.

10. B — An earthworm
   An earthworm is a soft, legless invertebrate.

11. A — Reduce, reuse and recycle
   Reduce, reuse and recycle are ways of managing waste.

12. D — Seeing worms in faeces, itchy anus, weakness
   These are signs that worms may be present.

13. B — Balance
   A balance is used to measure mass.

14. A — Throwing it in a river
   Throwing waste in rivers pollutes water.

15. A — Put it under cool running water and tell an adult
   Cool water reduces the burn.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: 16 litres in one day and 80 litres in five days.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 2 x 8, 1 mark for 16, 1 mark for 16 x 5 = 80.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water is taken back from the leftover food and the rest becomes faeces.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for water and 1 mark for faeces.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: The block moves slower or a shorter distance on the rough floor. Rough floors give more friction.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Stomach ache, bloating, diarrhoea, vomiting, constipation, worms (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Leaving taps running, leaking taps or pipes, using too much water for washing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: They keep their shape so we can build houses, make tools, furniture, clothes and shoes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct use.
